statement: A 2025 independent benchmark of multiple 3D structure-based generators found that deep-learning methods often failed to generate structurally valid molecules and realistic 3D conformations, motivating evaluation beyond standard 2D validity/novelty metrics.
locator: Abstract; Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling, DOI 10.1021/acs.jcim.5c01020
notes: Counterweight to generator papers evaluated mainly with surrogate metrics.
